_comment: English (United States). This catalog is the fallback source of truth: every key added here must also be added to zh_CN.json.

argparse.heading: %(heading)s:
argparse.help: show this help message and exit
argparse.one_of_required: one of the arguments %s is required

generate.description: Run distilabel pipeline for generating responses with DeepSeek R1

help.prompt_column: Column of the dataset containing the prompts
help.model: Model name to use for generation
help.max_new_tokens: Maximum number of new tokens to generate
help.client_replicas: Number of client replicas for parallel processing
help.retries: Number of retries for failed requests (default: 0)
help.hf_output_dataset: HuggingFace repo to push results to
help.private: Whether to make the output dataset private when pushing to HF Hub

help.dataset: Name of the dataset to check for contamination.
help.config: Name of the dataset config to load.
help.split: Split to check for contamination, defaults to `train`.
help.ngram_size: Size of n-grams to build, defaults to 8.
help.problem_column: Name of the column containing the problem (prompt).
help.cleanup: Whether to remove the contaminated rows before pushing the dataset.
help.new_dataset_name: New name for the dataset. If not provided, will reuse the name and add a `_decontaminated` to the name.

help.model_name: Hugging Face model name or path
help.default_tp: Default TP size (usually GPUs per node)

help.output_file: Path of the JSONL file the generations are appended to
help.prompt_column: Column of the dataset containing the prompts
help.uuid_column: Column used to deduplicate already processed examples
help.api_addr: Address of the OpenAI-compatible server, in `host:port` form
help.prompt_template: Template string for formatting prompts. Must contain a `{prompt}` placeholder.
help.max_tokens: Maximum number of new tokens to generate

help.model_id: The Hub model id to push the model to.
help.model_revision: The Hub model branch to push the model to.
help.benchmarks: The benchmarks to run after training.
help.system_prompt: The system prompt to use for the benchmark.

help.host: Hostname or IP address the server binds to
help.max_num_sandboxes: Maximum number of sandboxes that can be created simultaneously
help.api_key: MorphCloud API key; falls back to the MORPH_API_KEY environment variable

script.dataset_name: Dataset name. Can be omitted if using dataset_mixture.
script.dataset_mixture: Configuration for creating dataset mixtures with advanced options like shuffling.

grpo.benchmarks: The benchmarks to run after training.
grpo.callbacks: The callbacks to run during training.
grpo.hub_model_revision: The Hub model branch to push the model to.
grpo.overwrite_hub_revision: Whether to overwrite the Hub revision.
grpo.push_to_hub_revision: Whether to push to a Hub revision/branch.
grpo.system_prompt: The optional system prompt to use.
grpo.wandb_log_unique_prompts: Whether to log the unique prompts to wandb. This will create a new run for each unique prompt.
grpo.wandb_entity: The entity to store runs under.
grpo.wandb_project: The project to store runs under.
grpo.wandb_run_group: The group to store runs under.

sft.benchmarks: The benchmarks to run after training.
sft.callbacks: The callbacks to run during training.
sft.system_prompt: The optional system prompt to use for benchmarking.
sft.hub_model_revision: The Hub model branch to push the model to.
sft.overwrite_hub_revision: Whether to overwrite the Hub revision.
sft.push_to_hub_revision: Whether to push to a Hub revision/branch.
sft.wandb_entity: The entity to store runs under.
sft.wandb_project: The project to store runs under.
sft.wandb_run_group: The group to store runs under.

grpo_script.reward_funcs: List of reward functions. Possible values: 'accuracy', 'format', 'reasoning_steps', 'cosine', 'repetition_penalty', 'length', tag_count', 'code', 'code_format'
grpo_script.repetition_n_grams: Number of n-grams for repetition penalty reward
grpo_script.repetition_max_penalty: Maximum (negative) penalty for for repetition penalty reward
grpo_script.code_language: Language for code format reward. Based on E2B supported languages https://e2b.dev/docs/code-interpreting/supported-languages
grpo_script.code_eval_test_batch_size: for each generation, evaluate these many test cases in parallel, then check if any of them failed (0 score): if so stop evaluating; otherwise continue with the next batch of test cases. Useful to avoid overloading the eval server + save time on wrong solutions
grpo_script.code_eval_scoring_mode: use fraction of passed test cases as reward. If false, use 0/1 scoring.
grpo_script.parallel_code_exec_per_proc: Number of parallel E2B code executions per process. Default of 2 is suitable for the Free Hobby tier of E2B with 8 GPUs used for training.
grpo_script.dataset_prompt_column: Column to use as prompts for training.
grpo_script.e2b_router_url: URL for the E2B router. See scripts/e2b_router.py
grpo_script.morph_router_url: URL for the MorphCloud router. See scripts/morph_router.py
grpo_script.ioi_provider: Provider for IOI code execution. Options: 'piston', 'morph'.
grpo_script.max_completion_len: Maximum number of characters in completion.
grpo_script.soft_punish_cache: Minimum number of characters in completion.
